notes: Padma Oil 'AGENT/CUSTOMER LIST' PDFs (dealer = filling station; LPG dealer), one heading per district; A/C name and address as printed (English, upper case), split at the printed column; district heading normalised to the seed (heading kept in extra_json); upazila only where exactly one upazila name of that district occurs in the address (noted).
